messages.author: 376946a09bed536f
messages.subject: IRTpars SEs for multipleGroup models
parts:
Dear Phil, 

I am attempting calculate standard errors for my estimated parameters using IRTpars = TRUE and printSE=TRUE; however, I've noticed that these only successfully return standard errors (I'm assuming through the delta method) for a and b when the model specified is a SingleGroup model. When trying to extract classic IRT parameterization standard errors from a multipleGroup model, I get nothing. For example:

m1 <-multipleGroup(data1, 1, group = Group, SE = TRUE, invariance=c('Item4','Item6','Item10', 'free_means', 'free_var'), technical=list(NCYCLES=2000), optimizer='nlminb')

coef(m1, printSE=TRUE, IRTpars=TRUE)$'1'$'Item1'
           a         b1        b2       b3
par 2.158052 -0.0158865 0.6762897 1.014574

Above I attempted to extract standard errors for the first item from the first of five groups.

Below is a similar single group model for that first group: 

m2 <- mirt(data = Group1, model = 1, itemtype = itemtype, SE = TRUE)

coef(m2, printSE=TRUE, IRTpars=TRUE)$'Item1'
            a          b1         b2        b3
par 2.1745437 -0.01088077 0.67841116 1.0146716
SE  0.2833637  0.08593305 0.09650358 0.1137208


Any help would be greatly appreciated! Thank you!

Best,
Alex

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: IRTpars SEs for multipleGroup models
parts:
Hi Alex,

I confirmed this behaviour with a different example, and it looks like it just wasn't supported yet (I didn't pass the full ACOV matrix down to the delta method functions). Should be fixed on the dev on Github. Thanks for the report!

Phil
